signature_documentation_update.argument_boundary: int -> (int int) retains one complete structural TYPE candidate. Grouping selects current-level sequences only under a sequence-consuming contract; there is no repeated RHS-opening pass.
signature_documentation_update.consumer_clarification: Receiver contracts determine argument roles; modifiers and :: consume DATA. Common namespace field consumption reads immediate declarations without an RHS evaluator inside ::. Expression consumes the clean graph: anonymous Structures are groups; a named Structure is a group only if its actual parent differs from the current lexical parent, otherwise ordinary receiver/call processing applies. Graph references preserve actual parent and identity. Group planning and single-left/right-Array application preparation are separate.
signature_documentation_update.implementation_evidence: The supplied library builds ready descriptions through FxSignatures.make; builtin :: source, parser, translator and LMX runtime are absent. Execution NOT_RUN.

grouping_correction.removed_assumption: Removed the unapproved TYPE-tail profile, the invented DATA/value selector and eval RHS inside ::, the unsupported builtin PASS flag, and the mistaken universal DATA-to-user-Structure interpretation. grouping_correction.structural_rule: Pure graph traversal; anonymous => group; named foreign-parent => group; named same-lexical-parent => ordinary receiver/call. The grouper never sees parentheses, never reparents references and does not replace receiving roles.
grouping_correction.operand_template_status: FINAL_UNCHANGED: one left reference and right Array of references; no open generalization proposal.
grouping_correction.grouper_and_adapter: Grouper handles priorities, complete expressions and current-level sequences. The separate application adapter packages one left actual and right references; no second unwrapping. Prefix positions retain ABSENT left.
grouping_correction.library_algorithm_bodies: UNCHANGED; graph terminology in a collector comment and two illustrative assignment forms changed.
grouping_correction.method_only_form_equivalence: (:= a 1) enters the operand method with ABSENT left and right [a,1]; (a := 1) enters with left a and right [1]. Only the method implements equivalent assignment. Parser and transport do not normalize the vectors.
grouping_correction.no_assignment_parser_exception: Every left view preserves one occurrence and its value context. Parsing has no assignment/PLACE/NAME branch; actual consumption is method/namespace work. Attached unary forms share one left/right-oriented class.
